text: The Board confirms that this nominee is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates. Thank you for your consideration of this matter.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidate to the Eastview Neighbourhood Community Centre Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for the term ending June 30, 2023 and until a successor is appointed: Moneca Delain.
